name: Summer Fun Program
operator_name: Boys & Girls Club of Greater New Bedford
description_short: A weekday summer program (9am-4pm) at the Boys & Girls Club of Greater New Bedford, with outdoor games, gym sports, a games room, a makerspace (coding, digital art, 3D printing), arts and crafts, gardening, cooking and planned field trips. Children must be Club members.
activities: Softball, flag football, relay races and water games
Basketball, volleyball, soccer, kickball and gym games
Billiards, table tennis and board games
Makerspace: coding, Scratch, digital art and music, 3D modeling and printing
Field trips (hikes, library, art tours, farm tours)
refund_policy_summary: No refunds. Weekly fees are charged at the full week's rate regardless of how many days the child attends. Each week's payment is due the Thursday before it starts.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2023 season ("2023 SUMMER FUN PROGRAM"). Today is 2026-10-13, so all dates and prices are out of date and may not apply to 2027.
The page does not list individual weeks. The 8 weekly sessions come from splitting the stated July 3 – August 25 Mon–Fri span into weeks. The page does not say whether the program runs on July 4.
Extra costs on top of the weekly fee: a required annual Club membership ($50 in 2023) and extended care at $10 per day.
Lunch is the state's free lunch program and is optional. The concession stand is closed.
